content: Restore backend files (server.py, emails.py, logo_seed.txt) to /app/backend
Update backend/.env (preserve MONGO_URL, add DB_NAME/OWNER vars)
Restore frontend source (src/, public/index.html, tailwind.config.js) to /app/frontend
Install frontend deps (jspdf) via yarn add
Restart services and verify app runs end-to-end
